title: PhD Program
institution: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)
field: Natural sciences, mathematics and computer science
about: ISTA Graduate School PhD program for the 2027 intake, open to bachelor's and master's holders. No application fee; three reference letters required. Program starts 15 September 2027; the application portal opens in late October 2026.
requirements: Bachelor's or master's degree (at least second year of bachelor's completed before the start date)
Three reference letters, at least two from an academic/research environment

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "ISTA Graduate School PhD program" (doctoral research in "Natural sciences, mathematics and computer science") → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"at least two from an academic/research environment" (research-oriented profile expected) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
